title: [review] dao_manager.py: No thread safety for concurrent access
description: Line 67: _apply_dao_at, expire_routes, remove_edge, and build_dao all mutate shared state (_parent_map, _candidate_map, _edge_expiry, etc.) without locks. Concurrent calls can interleave reads and writes, corrupting internal state. Fix: Add threading.Lock or document single-threaded requirement.
close_reason: Fixed: Added threading.Lock to DaoManager for thread safety. Wrapped _build_dao, _apply_dao_at, expire_routes, and remove_edge methods with lock acquisition. All mutating methods now delegate to _unlocked variants under the lock.
